bookings_price_check.name: bookings_price_check
bookings_price_check.value:
("bookings"."package_id" IS NULL AND "bookings"."season_id" IS NULL AND num_nonnulls("bookings"."base_price", "bookings"."extra_guests_amount",
          "bookings"."items_total", "bookings"."removal_credits_total", "bookings"."discount_amount", "bookings"."total", "bookings"."base_guests", "bookings"."extra_guest_price") = 0)
      OR ("bookings"."package_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."guests" IS NOT NULL AND num_nulls("bookings"."base_price", "bookings"."extra_guests_amount",
          "bookings"."items_total", "bookings"."removal_credits_total", "bookings"."discount_amount", "bookings"."total", "bookings"."base_guests", "bookings"."extra_guest_price") = 0)

bookings_amounts_check.name: bookings_amounts_check
bookings_amounts_check.value:
"bookings"."base_price" >= 0 AND "bookings"."extra_guests_amount" >= 0 AND "bookings"."items_total" >= 0 AND "bookings"."removal_credits_total" >= 0
        AND "bookings"."discount_amount" >= 0 AND "bookings"."total" >= 0 AND "bookings"."base_guests" >= 0 AND "bookings"."extra_guest_price" >= 0

bookings_confirmed_check.name: bookings_confirmed_check
bookings_confirmed_check.value:
"bookings"."status" <> 'confirmed' OR ("bookings"."event_type_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."package_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "bookings"."guests" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."total" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "bookings"."confirmed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."cancellation_basis" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."cancellation_tiers" IS NOT NULL)

bookings_cancelled_check.name: bookings_cancelled_check
bookings_cancelled_check.value: "bookings"."status" <> 'cancelled' OR ("bookings"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."cancelled_by" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL)

bookings_names_check.name: bookings_names_check
bookings_names_check.value:
("bookings"."groom_name" IS NULL OR length("bookings"."groom_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 80)
        AND ("bookings"."bride_name" IS NULL OR length("bookings"."bride_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 80)

discount_requests_decision_check.name: discount_requests_decision_check
discount_requests_decision_check.value:
("discount_requests"."status" = 'pending') = ("discount_requests"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "discount_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("discount_requests"."status" <> 'pending' OR "discount_requests"."decision_note" IS NULL)
        AND ("discount_requests"."decision_note" IS NULL OR length("discount_requests"."decision_note") <= 300)

payments_void_check.name: payments_void_check
payments_void_check.value:
num_nonnulls("payments"."voided_at", "payments"."voided_by", "payments"."void_reason") IN (0, 3)
        AND ("payments"."void_reason" IS NULL OR length("payments"."void_reason") BETWEEN 3 AND 300)
